items.headline: Mississippi State QB Kamario Taylor, RB Fluff Bothwell questionable vs. LSU
items.description: Mississippi State quarterback Kamario Taylor is questionable to play against LSU because of a leg injury that forced him out of the Bulldogs' game against Alabama two weeks ago. Leading rusher Fluff Bothwell is also questionable.

items.headline: SEC in filing: LSU dispute remains 'live,' school lacks institutional control
items.description: The SEC is opposing LSU's request to dismiss the conference's lawsuit against the university and its officials, saying a live controversy still exists between the parties.

items.headline: Zxavian Harris eligible to sign with NFL teams despite bid to play for LSU
items.description: The NFL has reversed course and now says that former Ole Miss DL Zxavian Harris is free to sign with teams this season after a failed attempt to return to college football at LSU.
